title: Docs integration: Project-scoped repository search/read through Obot MCP
body:
Parent epic: https://github.com/bin0110001/cezar-factory/issues/174

## Objective
Make a source-grounded documentation knowledge layer available to coding agents through the existing Factory MCP/skill provisioning path, avoiding token-heavy wiki dumps.

## Tasks
- [ ] Integrate chosen documentation backend behind read-only search/read adapter. Prefer OpenWiki search/read if benchmark confirms; maintain backend-independent tool contract and fallback to checked-in docs.
- [ ] Scope tools by repo/project/branch/commit and identity; expose anchored snippets, source SHA, freshness, evidence link and bounded result size.
- [ ] Inject via existing Obot MCP gateway and runner adapters (#164 #165 #167), with project-specific skills/resolver (#168 #169), dev/stable publication (#170).
- [ ] Add concise agent instructions: when to query, when to inspect source directly, how to spot stale/contradictory claims; no full-context auto-injection.
- [ ] Validate cross-tenant/project isolation, private repo permissions, sandbox auth, tool timeout, retry/cache, offline availability and prompt-injection resistance in retrieved docs.
- [ ] Respect licensed asset/data exclusions; audit documentation access without logging secrets.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Agent can answer a question with grounded document+source references and relevant SHA in both pilot repos.
- [ ] Stale/index-absent results visibly marked and tool fails safely; code editing continues when optional service is down.
- [ ] Unauthorized workspace/repo reads denied in automated tests.
- [ ] Retrieval budget caps and p95 latency captured in Langfuse/OTel.
## Dependencies
Epic https://github.com/bin0110001/cezar-factory/issues/174; **blocked by** generator selection and documentation contract; integrate with #164 #167 #169 #170 #172.
